findings.claim: The requirement names three unguarded `DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]` sites in TypeCollector (reporter's lines 735, 1009 and 1101). The diff guards only two of them: BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull (old 1009, now 985) and MemberNeedsKey (old 1101, now 1077). No hunk touches the code at the reporter's line 735, which is roughly line 711 in this tree given the same 24-line offset. The new `ReportIfLocatedInCompilation` wrapper only filters a diagnostic after it is created. If that remaining site computes its location via `DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]`, the IndexOutOfRangeException is still thrown before the filter runs, and the analyzer (and possibly the generator) still crash on the repro. The requirement says the reporter did not narrow down which site fires, so all three need guarding to meet 'do not throw'.
